_contract: Perf baseline for scripts/ci/perf-gate.sh (two signals, schema 2). .ir: Callgrind Ir totals per script (blocks, ir_total) — deterministic, gated at meta.threshold_pct (D1: 2%). .wall: wall-clock ns/block per script (blocks, ns_per_block) — median of repeat=10 renders after warmup=3 on the same workload, gated at meta.wall_threshold_pct (25%). All numbers are ONLY valid for the exact toolchain in meta (compiler, container, valgrind, bench_version) — a change to any of them invalidates every number and must go through .github/workflows/regenerate-perf-baseline.yml (manual dispatch on the PR branch, D4) or the local docker one-liner in the gate script's header. Wall is a TREND signal, not a bit-deterministic one (shared-runner clock noise): its 25% band is a generous safety net for cache/allocation/algorithmic regressions the Ir gate cannot see, and its numbers are only meaningful as that safety net — never as an exact reference. Regen rewrites BOTH sections; entries must stay key- and blocks-aligned between them.
